text:
The gate code for the BTS-210 site has been updated to 9035, and the gate needs to be lifted slightly to open due to a sticky padlock. 

1. Use the code 9035.
2. Lift the gate slightly to open it.

We have low confidence in this (confidence 0.5, based on 1 observation by Tiina Tuominen via teams on 2025-10-20).
